justification: Inspected android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/camera/CameraManager.java plus android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/CaptureActivity.java, CaptureActivityHandler.java, AmbientLightManager.java, ViewfinderView.java, and DecodeHandler.java. CameraManager is the shared camera hub: it exposes many operations (openDriver, closeDriver, startPreview, stopPreview, setTorch, requestPreviewFrame, getFramingRect, getFramingRectInPreview, setManualCameraId, setManualFramingRect, buildLuminanceSource) and depends on multiple collaborators (CameraConfigurationManager, OpenCamera, OpenCameraInterface, AutoFocusManager, PreviewCallback, plus Android camera/graphics types). It also has clear fan-in from at least five client classes: CaptureActivity, CaptureActivityHandler, AmbientLightManager, ViewfinderView, and DecodeHandler (through CaptureActivity.getCameraManager), which is strong evidence of hub-like modularization.
